_comment: Festival windows as DATA — reviewed and committed, never scraped or inferred (docs/design/FESTIVAL_SPECIAL_SITUATIONS_v1.md piece 1; founder-ratified mode 2026-08-05: 'automatic daily inside festival windows'). 'Inside a window' is PHASED (tools/festival_phase.py; decision record docs/memory/decisions/2026-08-05_festival-window-phases.md): announce (months out — the standing weekly full sweep covers it), rampup (starts-28d..starts-1d — daily keyword_pack sweep), live (starts..ends — daily FULL sweep + keyword sweep), winddown (ends+1d — one more keyword sweep). Optional per-window overrides: rampup_days (default 28), winddown_days (default 1); widening a band raises spend — docs/ops/SEARCH_QUOTA_BUDGET.md governs. Dates are inclusive; timezone America/Chicago.
